provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Bomb Busters rulebook (Pegasus Spiele, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Pick a Mission card (play them in order)
Captain: random for the first mission, then passes left; Captain card in front of them, everyone else picks a character card
Captain reads the Mission card aloud and leaves it flipped at the bottom left of the board
Take all 48 blue wires (not in training missions 1-3) plus the number of random red and yellow wires the Mission card shows
Mark the drawn red and yellow values on the board with their markers, blank side up
Shuffle all wires facedown and deal them as evenly as possible among all tile stands
Sort your wires in ascending order left to right, facing you
steps.note: With 2 stands, deal and sort each separately

steps.text: From the Captain clockwise: Dual Cut, Solo Cut or Reveal Your Red Wires
